newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds close higher with peripherals.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds close higher with peripherals.

text.p: Portuguese bonds closed higher in line with peripheral markets, pleased by U.S. producer price data, and the market focused on tomorrow's U.S. consumer price figures, dealers said.
"Futures and cash closed higher with peripheral markets after U.S. producer prices showed no inflationary tendencies and our August inflation result was favourable," said one operator.
Another operator said: "Spain will continue to show the way tomorrow."

The money market closed steady after the Bank of Portugal left its key absorption and emergency lending rates unchanged today. One month money stood at 7.15/7.22 percent, compared with 7.16/7.2 percent at the opening.
